FULL TEXT:
Centre for Himalayan and Trans Himalayan Studies and Department of Political Science,
University of Ladakh, Leh
In Collaboration with
Dr. B. R. Ambedkar University Delhi, Delhi
Date: 20/11/2026
Subject: Engagement of a Project Staff
Applications are invited from eligible candidates for the following temporary project
position in the Department of Science and Technology, Ministry of Science and Technology,
funded Project titled, “Preservation, Promotion, and Documentation of Folk Traditions: A
Study of Ladakh” under Science and Heritage Research Initiative (SHRI) of the Government
of India.
2. Details for the post of Project Assistant (PA)
Position Project Assistant (PA)
Number of
Positions
(1) one
Nature of
engagement
Purely on a Temporary basis to be engaged for fieldwork and other
research work on a need basis.
Duration Till 31st March 2027
Essential
Qualification
1. MA/MSc in Anthropology/ Sociology/ Psychology/ Public Health/
English/Cultural Studies/ Political Science / Heritage Studies/Geography
with at least 55% marks in aggregate or its equivalent grade in a point
scale wherever grading system is followed or equivalent qualification
from a foreign educational institution accredited by an assessment and
accreditation agency which is approved, recognized or authorized by an
authority, established or incorporated under a law in its home country
or any other statutory authority in that country to assess, accredit or
assure quality and standards of the educational institution.
A relaxation of 5% marks or its equivalent grade may be allowed for
those belonging to SC/ST/OBC (non-creamy layer)/Differently-Abled,
Economically Weaker Section (EWS), and other categories of candidates
as per the decision of the Commission from time to time.
Desirable: The candidates with past research experience will be given preference.
Remuneration 20,000.00/ + 2000.00 (10% HRA) =22,000 per month (as per the norms
of the funding agency), subject to release of funds.
Last date for
applying
26th November 2026
How to Apply:
Applicants must send the following signed documents (by speed post or email) to the official
address of the Principal Investigator.
a. A detailed resume with contact details, including phone number, email ID, and postal
address.
b. Photocopies of educational/professional qualifications, and publications (if any).
c. One (1) page “Statement of Interest”.
The detailed resume and documents can be sent by email to deanreseach@uol.ac.in , latest
by 26th November 2026
The candidates are advised to keep visiting the University of Ladakh website for further
updates and the status of their candidature @ University of Ladakh
Dr. Sonam Joldan
Associate Professor
